missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes a query method to return all questions for a given subject with fields required by the Question Gallery UI, and listSuggestions() remains compatible with generated TS types (suggestions array + count).

Additionally, the frontend summary indicates listSuggestions returns an array directly (not {suggestions, count}), which would violate the required response shape.
evidence: backend/main.mo (truncated; types only shown, no APIs visible)
frontend-file-summaries.txt (useQueries.ts: "suggestions (listSuggestions returns array directly, throws on error)")
